 [![](https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/public/images/skin_1/notification_icon_flag_dark.png?v=1)Report this post](javascript:Forum_ShowReportDialog( '103582791434161031', '619569341084249327', '620712364025782570', '28886909', '620712364025998597' );)

Currently the only way to open without using gems is to get a character to 20 and then work on the daily quests from the extra npc, not the normal dailies. As you gather wyvern tokens you can then use those tokens to buy keys.  
  
Basically, as those chests are one of the primary ways they expect the game to make money, opening them without using money is going to take a long time. So sell most of your chests because you will get many more before you start opening them.
